game.aegyo-pop.controls: Drag to aim and release to fire. Arrow keys and Space work too.
game.aegyo-pop.intro.1: Drag to aim, then lift to launch the lightstick orb.
game.aegyo-pop.intro.2: Match 3 or more identical fan badges to pop them.
game.aegyo-pop.intro.3: Keep every orb above the red danger line.
game.aegyo-pop.intro.4: Rainbow bombs clear a color; icy orbs need two hits.
game.aegyo-pop.intro.5: Rescue trapped hearts and clear all 5 levels.
game.aegyo-pop.intro.subtitle: Aim. Match. Pop!
game.aegyo-pop.intro.title: Aegyo Pop
game.aegyo-pop.tagline: Aim, bank shots, and match fan-badge orbs across five neon levels.
game.aegyo-pop.title: Aegyo Pop
game.aegyo-pop.toast.danger: ⚠️ DANGER! STAY ABOVE THE RED LINE!
game.aegyo-pop.transition.title: LEVEL {level}
game.claw.controls: Steer with all four arrows, then hit DROP over your pick.
game.claw.tagline: Drop the claw, catch a virtual plush. Just for fun, no physical prize.
game.claw.title: Aegyo Claw
game.bias-match.controls: Tap two photocards to reveal them and find every matching pair.
game.bias-match.intro.1: Tap 2 cards to find each matching pair.
game.bias-match.intro.2: Memorize the peek at the start of every level.
game.bias-match.intro.3: Every mistake costs 1 life. You get 5 each level.
game.bias-match.intro.5: Clear all 5 levels as the grid grows.
game.bias-match.intro.subtitle: Find your bias twice!
game.bias-match.intro.title: Bias Match
game.bias-match.tagline: Memorize the photocards and find every matching bias pair.
game.bias-match.title: Bias Match
game.flappy.controls: Tap anywhere to flap. Your first tap starts the level.
game.flappy.intro.1: Tap (or press space) to flap. Gravity does the rest.
game.flappy.intro.2: Slip between the giant lightsticks — touch one and you restart the level.
game.flappy.intro.3: 5 levels to reach the front row. More gates, tighter gaps, faster crowd.
game.flappy.intro.4: Hearts follow our girl all the way — she's a true stan.
game.flappy.intro.5: The clock never stops (crashes included). You can leave anytime and keep your score.
game.flappy.quitBody: Your run ends here — the score you're holding stands.
game.flappy.tagline: Fly to the front row. Slip between giant lightsticks — crash and you retry the level.
game.flappy.title: Bias Flap
game.fanchant-hero.controls: Tap a lane when the freebie reaches the line. D, F, J, and K work too.
game.fanchant-hero.intro.1: Your idols throw concert freebies down four lanes.
game.fanchant-hero.intro.2: Tap the lane when each freebie reaches the neon line.
game.fanchant-hero.intro.3: PERFECT catches score the most and grow your combo.
game.fanchant-hero.intro.4: Follow the beat and don't drop a single freebie.
game.fanchant-hero.intro.subtitle: Feel the beat, fan!
game.fanchant-hero.intro.title: Fanchant Hero
game.fanchant-hero.tagline: Catch concert freebies on the beat. Chase a perfect fanchant combo.
game.fanchant-hero.title: Fanchant Hero
game.freebie.controls: Drag to catch the falling merch. Arrow keys work too.
game.freebie.intro.1: Drag left and right to move your catcher.
game.freebie.intro.2: Catch the falling merch. Miss three times in a level and the run ends.
game.freebie.intro.3: Chain catches to build a combo for bonus points.
game.freebie.intro.4: Clear all 5 levels and chain combos to rank higher.
game.freebie.recap.headline: Nice clearing!
game.freebie.tagline: Catch the swag before it drops.
game.freebie.title: Freebie Frenzy
game.frogger.controls: FORWARD and BACK only. Cross when the street is clear.
game.frogger.intro.1: Tap forward and back to cross the street.
game.frogger.intro.2: Dodge carts, trucks, scalpers, and security.
game.frogger.intro.3: Reach the top to clear each level. 3 lives.
game.frogger.intro.4: 5 levels, and each one is faster than the last.
game.frogger.tagline: Get to the LE SSERAFIM show. Dodge the street, get past security. 5 levels, 3 lives.
game.frogger.title: Cross to the Concert
game.hangman.controls: Tap letters to guess the fan slang before your guesses run out.
game.hangman.hint.aegyo: Cute, exaggerated charm an idol performs.
game.hangman.hint.bias: Your favorite member in a group.
game.hangman.hint.comeback: A group's return with new music after a break.
game.hangman.hint.daebak: Slang for something amazing, a jackpot moment.
game.hangman.hint.fanchant: What the crowd shouts along during a song.
game.hangman.hint.maknae: The youngest member of a group.
game.hangman.hint.sasaeng: An obsessive fan who crosses privacy lines.
game.hangman.status.lost: Out of guesses! The word was {term}.
game.hangman.status.solved: Daebak! Solved with {lives} guesses to spare.
game.hangman.tagline: Crack the fan slang before you run out of guesses.
game.hangman.title: Guess the Slang
game.jumper.controls: Tap the left or right half: near center is a small nudge, near an edge is a big nudge.
game.jumper.intro.1: Your idol auto-bounces. Tap either half of the screen to steer.
game.jumper.intro.2: Tap near the center for a small nudge, or near an edge for a bigger move.
game.jumper.intro.3: Land on neon bars and moving CDs. Photocards crack, then break.
game.jumper.intro.4: Dodge paparazzi drones and collect notes, hearts, speakers, and golden mics.
game.jumper.intro.5: Climb from chart rank #100 all the way to #1. You have 3 lives.
game.jumper.tagline: Bounce up the charts. Don't flop off the top 100.
game.jumper.title: Comeback Climb
game.photocard-stack.controls: Tap anywhere (or press Space) to drop the moving photocard.
game.photocard-stack.end.title: TOPPLED!
game.photocard-stack.intro.1: Tap anywhere to drop the moving photocard.
game.photocard-stack.intro.2: Line it up - any overhang gets trimmed away.
game.photocard-stack.intro.3: PERFECT stacks keep their full width and build a combo.
game.photocard-stack.intro.4: Reach every tenth card to unlock a holo bonus.
game.photocard-stack.intro.subtitle: Stack your collection!
game.photocard-stack.intro.title: Photocard Stack
game.photocard-stack.tagline: Drop, trim, and stack your photocard collection sky-high.
game.photocard-stack.title: Photocard Stack
game.snake.controls: Swipe or use the d-pad to steer. You move on your first input.
game.snake.intro.1: Swipe anywhere, or tap the d-pad, to steer.
game.snake.intro.2: Eat gift boxes. Each freebie joins your chain and it grows.
game.snake.intro.3: Hit a wall or yourself and you lose a life. 3 per level.
game.snake.intro.subtitle: Catch every freebie, fan!
game.snake.intro.title: Snake Freebies
game.snake.tagline: Grow a chain of freebies. 3 levels, 3 lives, one arena.
game.snake.title: Snake Freebies
game.thisorthat.controls: Tap a card (or press the left/right arrows) to pick. Nine rounds.
game.thisorthat.tagline: Nine quick picks. Find your fan-day vibe.
game.thisorthat.title: Fan Day: This or That
game.thisorthat.vibe.adventurous.blurb: Sunrises, night markets, new streets. Your fan day is an expedition.
game.thisorthat.vibe.adventurous.name: Adventurous
game.thisorthat.vibe.cozy.blurb: Soft blankets, warm snacks, favorite B-sides. Your fan day recharges you.
game.thisorthat.vibe.cozy.name: Cozy
game.thisorthat.vibe.creative.blurb: Charms, fan art, playlists. You turn fandom into something you made.
game.thisorthat.vibe.creative.name: Creative
game.thisorthat.vibe.energetic.blurb: Choreo, arcades, one more round of everything. You ARE the encore.
game.thisorthat.vibe.energetic.name: Energetic
game.thisorthat.vibe.social.blurb: Karaoke, group chats, shared fries. Your fan day is better with everyone in it.
game.thisorthat.vibe.social.name: Social

install.android.step1: Tap the menu (three dots, top right).
install.android.step2: Tap "Add to Home screen" or "Install app".
install.android.step3: Confirm. Launch it like any other app.
install.android.title: Android (Chrome)
install.desktop.step1: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
install.desktop.step2: Click "Install". Aegyo Arena opens in its own window.
install.desktop.title: Computer (Chrome / Edge)
install.intro: Aegyo Arena installs like an app: full screen, one tap away, no store needed.
install.ios.step1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
install.ios.step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
install.ios.step3: Tap "Add". The bunny appears on your home screen.
install.ios.title: iPhone / iPad (Safari)
install.title: Play from your home screen
portal.tagline: K-pop mini-games. Light, fast, one hand.
portal.title: Aegyo Arena
